findings.claim: The moved serializer restored the §13.4/§14.3 absent-vs-zero rationale but dropped the sentence that bounded who may call it — that these counts are admissible only on the owner's own read, and that the share snapshot and conversation export deliberately keep selects which do not name these columns (§13.3) — which now matters more, not less, because the helper is an exported module-level function rather than an inline map in one owner-scoped route.
findings.reproduction: `rg -n 'memoryUsedCount|knowledgeChunkCount' app/api` returns only app/api/chat/{route,preflight/route,context/route}.ts, i.e. no share or export route selects these columns today; `git show ec043cf7:app/api/conversations/\[conversationId\]/route.ts | rg -n '13.3'` shows the §13.3 boundary note that existed at the old emission site, and `rg -n '13\.3' lib/publicChatMessage.ts` returns nothing. Expected: the shared serializer's comment states the owner-read scope, so the next caller of an exported helper is told the constraint at the place it is enforced.

findings.claim: The completed POST reattachment now reports the canonical body and searchMetadata to `onResponseComplete`, but the polling path that replaces the same bubble with the same validated canonical Message reports nothing, so a turn recovered by polling still leaves the web-search retry offer and the response analytics uncorrected — an asymmetry this change introduced by upgrading only one of the two paths.
findings.reproduction: In tests/e2e/chat-unified-workspace.spec.ts, the 'terminal polling hydrates citations...' test drives a streaming→completed transition with `searchMetadata.executed: true`; instrument `onResponseComplete` (app/(site)/(application)/chat/ChatPageClient.tsx:5073) and observe it is never invoked for that turn, while the 'already-running attempt completed once' reattachment fixture in installControlledChatFetch does invoke it. Expected, if the two paths are meant to agree: polling fires the same callback with `completedMessage.content` and `completedMessage.searchMetadata` once it accepts a terminal canonical Message.

verdict.nextAction: Approved: all four round-0 findings are verifiably fixed (validation now precedes `transientFailures.delete` at ChatApp.tsx:1058-1067 so the exponential backoff survives repeated malformed envelopes; `citations.some(c => !isRecord(c))` at chatDurableRecoveryClient.ts:399 stops a non-object element reaching the sanitizer; the §13.4/§14.3 and user-attachment-persistence §4 citations are back in the shared serializer; and the reattachment analytics callback now uses the canonical content and searchMetadata) — the server allowlist, ownership/model/status binding, the deep-research exclusion at route.ts:2104-2110, and both fail-closed paths hold, so the two remaining nits are recorded and the current version stands; the one evidence gap is that the control program ran two server-contract files rather than the full suite the criteria name.
